description: This file defines interfaces related to controller functionalities in the WPEFramework project, including system management, discovery, configuration, lifecycle management, and metadata. It primarily contains pure virtual class interfaces with method declarations and some structured data types, intended to be implemented elsewhere.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as rebooting, deleting files, cloning plugins, and getting environment variables.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for plugin configuration management, including persisting settings and retrieving configuration data.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle states and notifications about state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving system metadata such as proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the device.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a specified directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a specified plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates network discovery using SSDP with a specified TTL.

methods.name: DiscoveryResults
methods.description: Provides results from SSDP network discovery.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a sink for lifetime notifications.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a sink from lifetime notifications.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin by its callsign.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by its callsign.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin into hibernate state with an optional timeout.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a plugin.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a suspended plugin.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details about currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides the status of a plugin, including configuration details.

methods.name: Links
methods.description: Provides details about active connections.

methods.name: ProcessInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the framework process, such as worker pools.

methods.name: Subsystems
methods.description: Provides details on the currently active subsystems.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Provides version information about WPEFramework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information associated with a given index (thread).
